family: Five physical controls, q=x0*x1+x1*x2+x3*x4, edits x0=x1=1 excluding vertex (1,1,0,0,0); one retained independent data sign.
domain: One exact Boolean root and two fixed stopping policies: root x0 then minimum polar rows; root x1 then minimum polar rows.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh, rational physical edges/mixed faces, prime-log forms with rigorous intervals; root badness also exact integer powers.
